claims.span: On clean test images, Loamwise-ViT achieves higher top-1 accuracy (91.4 ± 0.4%) than Ferncastle-CNN (89.7 ± 0.4%)
claims.proposition: On clean test images, Loamwise-ViT achieves higher top-1 accuracy (91.4 ± 0.4%) than Ferncastle-CNN (89.7 ± 0.4%).
The mean paired difference in clean top-1 accuracy between Loamwise-ViT and Ferncastle-CNN is 1.7 points in favor of Loamwise-ViT.

claims.span: a statistically significant mean paired difference of 1.7 points (95% CI [1.14, 2.26], p = 0.0011)
claims.proposition: The mean paired difference in clean top-1 accuracy between Loamwise-ViT and Ferncastle-CNN is statistically significant, with a 95% confidence interval of [1.14, 2.26] and p = 0.0011.

claims.span: Loamwise-ViT also shows smaller mean accuracy drops than Ferncastle-CNN under motion blur (kernel lengths 3, 7, 11 px)
claims.proposition: Loamwise-ViT shows smaller mean accuracy drops than Ferncastle-CNN under motion blur at kernel lengths 3, 7, and 11 px.

claims.span: Loamwise-ViT also shows smaller mean accuracy drops than Ferncastle-CNN under motion blur (kernel lengths 3, 7, 11 px) and illumination change (brightness ×0.8, ×0.6, ×0.4)
claims.proposition: Loamwise-ViT shows smaller mean accuracy drops than Ferncastle-CNN under illumination changes at brightness ×0.8, ×0.6, and ×0.4.

claims.span: it exceeds the 2.0-point robustness criterion at the strongest blur (6.1 points at 11 px)
claims.proposition: Loamwise-ViT exceeds the 2.0-point robustness criterion at the strongest motion blur, with a 6.1-point mean accuracy drop at 11 px.

claims.span: and strongest illumination change (3.4 points at ×0.4)
claims.proposition: Loamwise-ViT exceeds the 2.0-point robustness criterion at the strongest illumination change, with a 3.4-point mean accuracy drop at brightness ×0.4.

claims.span: Under JPEG re-compression, Loamwise-ViT shows smaller mean accuracy drops than Ferncastle-CNN at every quality setting
claims.proposition: Under JPEG re-compression, Loamwise-ViT shows smaller mean accuracy drops than Ferncastle-CNN at every quality setting.

claims.span: the gap widening at lower quality
claims.proposition: The gap between the mean accuracy drops of Loamwise-ViT and Ferncastle-CNN widens at lower JPEG quality.
At JPEG quality 10, Loamwise-ViT has a 1.8-point mean accuracy drop versus Ferncastle-CNN's 9.8-point drop.

claims.span: Loamwise-ViT is robust to JPEG re-compression of test images at all evaluated quality settings (90, 70, 50, 30, 10)
claims.proposition: Loamwise-ViT is robust to JPEG re-compression of test images at all evaluated quality settings: 90, 70, 50, 30, and 10.

claims.span: mean accuracy drops of 0.1 to 1.8 points from clean
claims.proposition: Loamwise-ViT's mean accuracy drops under JPEG re-compression range from 0.1 to 1.8 points relative to clean accuracy.

claims.span: all within the pre-specified 2.0-point robustness criterion
claims.proposition: All of Loamwise-ViT's mean accuracy drops at the evaluated JPEG quality settings are within the pre-specified 2.0-point robustness criterion.
